notes.title: Update for sep 8.
notes.content:
+Added an intro character (You may have to start a new game for him to work properly)
*Minor bug fixes for the hotbar (Harvesting from drying rack with a full hotbar would make the weed disappear)

notes.title: Update for september 2.
notes.content:
+Added a hotbar
*Fixed being able to move 2 objects at the same time
*Reworked and fixed some issues with the objectives
*Changed the crosshair to a circle

notes.title: Update for 3. september
notes.content:
[i]You may have to create a new save for distributors to work[/i]
+Added icon to distributor request UI
+Added dialogue for regular distributor orders
*Fixed calendar not showing up properly
*Minor tweaks for distributor
*Fixed not getting EXP for harvesting weed and putting on packagingtable

notes.title: September 2. overhaul patch
notes.content:
* Reworked the entire distributor system (needs to be checked for bugs)
+ Added restockers
+ Added 24 hour cooldown between distributor visits
*Fixed levels from previous save games bleeding into new saves
